**Chinese name:** 林德气体（中国）有限公司 (Líndé Qìtǐ (Zhōngguó) Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A foreign (German/UK-headquartered) industrial gas major with confirmed on-the-ground manufacturing in China specifically to supply chip fabs — not merely a sales office. Linde built and started up dedicated ultra-high-purity nitrogen generation and air-separation plants in Shanghai under long-term (reportedly 20-year) supply contracts with named China fabs.
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Ultra-high-purity industrial and electronic gases (nitrogen, oxygen, argon, and specialty electronic gases) piped or delivered directly to fab customers — confirmed named customers include GTA Semiconductor and Shanghai Huali Microelectronics (HLMC), with broader on-site gas production facilities across China's major fab clusters.
